[KCD2] Striped Tonies instantly fails as soon as i am noticed by Anton and Franzi?!?!?!?
\[SOLVED\]

solution: 

i noticed that there was a 50g theft charge to an Adam Welvara (apparently he is associated with the LOTF DLC that i haven't touched yet.) that would only appear after Anton and Franzi started killing me so i figured that had to be the problem. So i loaded a save and started endangering guards or punching them to resolve my wanted level but that 50g charge wasn't there and i was still wanted on the map... then i started consulting google search AI and it said that even though Kuttenburg is one city, there are still regions in the city where crimes stay localized in and it was correct. i had to load all the way before i began the stroll with the miners and go near the west gate bathhouse and all that and fuck around until this specific guard stopped me, he was the only one that would actually shout at me to surrender but then i could finally resolve that little theft charge. Then I was able to finally continue with this fun quest. Even though I wish this didn't happen, I still like navigating bugs in this game like this. I've been following KCD since ESO first started making videos about it and henry had black hair so it's all part of the game for me. I just wish I was old enough back then to be a backer.

problem: 

Right when you walk around the corner after putting the underwear up. You're supposed to engage in a 3v4 fistfight but when Anton and Franzi see me they immediately aggro on me and the other 4 enemies run away... dunno if they're subconsciously aware that i stole something from them before (I'm 99% sure i haven't, most of my crime has been centralized in like 2 weapon shops this playthrough) or it's something else. is there some sort of console command i can do to maybe make myself invisible while i help them fight or maybe clear any and all crime logic in the game or something???
